subject: Medford Rotary Club Community Programs
overview: Host John Petrella interviewed Doug Shoup, a three-time president of the Medford Rotary Club, about the organization's history, local fundraising events, and charitable contributions to the Medford community.

items.title: Guest Introduction
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced guest Doug Shoup, a local architect and three-time president of the Medford Rotary Club.

items.title: Guest Personal Background
items.summary: Doug Shoup discussed his professional background operating an architecture practice in Medford Square and his entry into community volunteer work through the Chamber of Commerce and the Rotary Club.

items.title: History and Scope of Rotary International
items.summary: Shoup explained the historical origins of Rotary International, its global membership, and its international efforts to eradicate polio.

items.title: Club Structure and Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Shoup outlined the Medford Rotary Club's meeting schedule, its non-political and non-religious status, and the professional diversity of its members.

items.title: Fundraising Activities
items.summary: Shoup detailed the club's primary fundraising initiatives, which include an annual comedy night, a meat raffle, and a Super Bowl squares raffle.

items.title: Community Philanthropy and Programs
items.summary: Shoup highlighted several local charitable initiatives funded by the club, including holiday food gift cards, student scholarships, and annual dictionary distributions to third graders.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Broadcast Information
items.summary: Host John Petrella closed the show by thanking the guest and sharing the broadcast schedule and contact information for future program inquiries.
